concern: A squared mini-batch mean gradient can cancel across records and is not the usual diagonal empirical-Fisher estimate. Initial importance and sampling size also needed definitions.
correction: Average squared per-example supplied-label log-likelihood gradients; initialise importance to zero; sample exactly min(1024,n); evaluate at the final aggregate with dropout off; disclose the empirical-Fisher and online-EWC adaptations.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: Replay target timing and stochastic dropout could make stored dark targets depend on an already updated model or inconsistent scoring modes.
correction: Cache evaluation-mode logits before each update, read existing replay before inserting, match logits with dropout off and gradients enabled, and declare the adaptations and loss reductions.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: A historical seen-ID set grows beyond the claimed bounded memory, and record count alone does not describe retained bytes.
correction: Insert only on round 1/epoch 1; retain a scalar counter, pass cursor and RNG state; give Algorithm R; account for 381 raw bytes per slot and 190,500 per 500-slot client buffer, with overhead separate.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: The schedule has no recurring fresh attack class, so the class-aware rule degenerates to preserving all supplied new attack labels and filtering benign labels.
correction: Narrow the identified comparison to new-label protection at equal admitted volume; do not claim general recurring-class balancing or an independently demonstrated small-class benefit.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: Head-copy semantics and hidden optimisation defaults could yield different implementations.
correction: Keep all active output rows trainable; define new-row initialisation, Adam parameters, last-update selection, reset policy, loss means, no reweighting/oversampling and reproducibility metadata.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: Scores on families passing the support floor could be interpreted as whole-dataset IDS performance.
correction: Label eligible-subset outcomes; retain a separate descriptive full-inventory view with rare-family support and errors.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: Multiclass scores alone do not specify an alert decision or operational false-alarm denominator.
correction: Use the fixed multiclass argmax decision, alert on non-benign, and report attack misses and false alerts per 10,000 benchmark benign flows; do not invent a daily volume or deployment prevalence.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: Oracle replay-label repair changes future optimisation and admission, so it cannot isolate a direct gradient effect.
correction: Interpret it as the total downstream effect of that intervention, including mediated changes; preserve prior logits and weights and retain zero-repair pairs.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: The text claimed no learned feature transformation despite a fitted scaler, and a zero T0 feature range was unspecified.
correction: Describe the frozen scaler as the fitted transformation; use denominator one for zero range, no clipping/refitting, and finite transformed FP32 input checks.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: FIFO and class-balanced eviction were names without complete replacement rules.
correction: Define oldest-insertion FIFO and largest supplied-label occupancy eviction with deterministic ties; bound and charge the extra order metadata; retain first-pass-only insertion and no retuning.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: Stage-averaged ACC/BWT relied on disjoint benign cohorts without a declared allocation rule.
correction: Partition whole benign test components into four non-empty seeded cohorts before outcomes, use their union for cumulative metrics and require at least four test components.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: Attacker-site selection and the new importance RNG stream needed an explicit pairing contract.
correction: Sample the eligible attacker site uniformly; record independent importance sampling, poison, ordering, initialisation, replay and dropout streams, plus bounded checkpoint state.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: Immediate test access after each checkpoint could permit feedback into later scope or model choices.
correction: Write checkpoints first, evaluate after the complete locked run set, and version/disclose amendments after any test inspection.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: An industry-standard claim needs concrete research controls and must not be confused with certification or production readiness.
correction: Use NIST RMF/AML and NeurIPS guidance with primary citations; specify hashes, versions, predictions, resource counts, deviations and planned acceptance gates; retain independent-site/deployment validation as future work.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: The methodology overview omitted or blurred calibration, development, locked final runs and sealed-test information boundaries.
correction: Show T0/train/dev/test branches, the protocol lock, checkpoint-only evaluation and one-way analysis/reporting; give the external dataset its own audit and protocol.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: The framework omitted the actual label-poisoning entry point and could imply server access to client data.
correction: Show one-client E2 training-label corruption before admission, supplied-label-only class registration and model/count messages to the server.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: Once-per-stage setup and repeated broadcasts/optimisation were not clearly separated.
correction: Separate registry/head expansion/frozen admission from the repeat-round loop; show the final aggregate and the previous-stage parameter input.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: EWC retained state had no clear read/write lifecycle or stage-end update.
correction: Show local importance/anchor reads during updates and a single stage-end commit; restrict the computation to EI and preserve absent-client importance.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: Replay state was incomplete, and claiming E3/E4 had no poison ignored retained corrupted records.
correction: Show feature/label/ID/pre-update-logit/width tuples, read and write paths, persistent counter/cursor, and the distinction between no fresh corruption and retained poisoned memory.
status: Addressed in the proposal; experimental execution not claimed

concern: Crossed labels, ambiguous path intersections, isolated headings and a nearly empty final references page weakened readability.
correction: Route connectors outside labels, bridge independent paths, preserve native editable TikZ mirrors in a self-contained source, keep section starts with their content and compact references to two readable pages.
